subject: Recap & MAP: next steps + propose 2 demo windows
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evan Lee <evan.lee@cardinalcyber.com>, Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@cardinalcyber.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & MAP: next steps + propose 2 demo windows

Hi Evan / Maya —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and the mutual action plan (MAP) so we’re aligned on next steps:

- Summary from our discovery: you’re focused on reducing per-query inference cost across batch jobs and lowering tail latency for customer-facing endpoints. Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data handling, peak traffic windows 09:00–11:00 PT, and a Q4 pilot goal.
- Proposed next step: 30-minute product intro + short infra Q&A where we can show the latency/cost dashboards and a brief run-through of Dedicated vs Private options.

Propose two 30-min windows (both PT):
  1) Wed, Sep 22 — 10:00–10:30 PT
  2) Thu, Sep 23 — 11:30–12:00 PT

If either works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include the technical lead from our side (Ben) and the security touchpoint (Priyom) for a ~10-minute security checklist at the end. If those don’t fit, tell me two 30-min blocks next week and we’ll match calendars.

Attached: initial MAP (high level) and a blank SOW template for procurement to review ahead of time.

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132
[Attachment: MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf)] [Attachment: SOW-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Evan Lee <evan.lee@cardinalcyber.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@cardinalcyber.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 17:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & MAP: next steps + propose 2 demo windows

Thanks Marissa — good recap. Both items look right. We’d prefer the shorter session to focus on the hosted API first and validate latency profiles; if that all looks good we can schedule a Dedicated deep dive.

Option 1 (Wed 10:00) works for Maya and me. Can Ben join? Also: can you confirm if the session will show a sample dataset or only synthetic load? We’ll want to understand how close the demo is to our production traffic.

Evan
Director, Platform Engineering | Cardinal Cyber
ev an.lee@cardinalcyber.com | +1 617-555-0214

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Recap & MAP: next steps + propose 2 demo windows

Quick internal — Evan picked Wed 10:00 PT. Ben, can you lead the demo? Evan asked whether we can run a short pass with a small, representative sample (not production data) to show latencies. Priyom, can you prepare the 3-slide security checklist (data residency, KMS, audit logs) to run at the end of the 30m?

Tentative plan for Wed 10:00–10:30 PT:
- 10:00–10:05 — 2-min context and goals (Marissa)
- 10:05–10:20 — Product demo + live latency dashboard (Ben)
- 10:20–10:30 — Security checklist Q&A (Priyom)

Also note: attach MAP_v1.pdf and SOW-template.docx to the invite. I’ll send outbound confirmation to Evan & Maya once you confirm.

— Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evan Lee <evan.lee@cardinalcyber.com>, Maya Ortiz <maya.ortiz@cardinalcyber.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Sep 2026 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: 30-min product intro (Wed Sep 22, 10:00 PT)

Hi Evan / Maya —

Locked in for Wed, Sep 22 at 10:00–10:30 PT. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=demo-invite-0922

Agenda (30 min):
• 10:00–10:05 — Context & goals (Marissa)
• 10:05–10:20 — Live demo + latency/cost dashboard (Ben)
• 10:20–10:30 — Security checklist & next steps (Priyom)

Prep notes:
- Ben will run a demo with a small, representative sample (no PHI/prod data).
- Attached: MAP_v1.pdf for the mutual action plan and the SOW template for procurement review.
- If procurement wants an updated SOW draft after the demo, I’ll coordinate with our legal/finance teams and send a redline.

Next steps after the session: 1) confirm pilot scope & sizing, 2) procurement touchpoint (SOW), 3) pilot kickoff timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Marissa
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
